title: Variant Selection Record

selected_variant_id.description: Verbatim (variant_id/id/name/variant_name/label) or derived (str_{index}_{hash8} for bare strings / id-less dicts) -- see _derive_variant_id's docstring for the priority rule.

variant_definition.description: The matched expanded_variants entry, copied verbatim by code -- not re-summarized by an LLM. Either a dict (the majority shape) or a bare string.

instrument.description: Resolved: the variant's own override if present, else inherited from the parent hypothesis_card.yaml's target_market.

timeframe.description: Resolved: the variant's own override if present, else inherited from the parent hypothesis_card.yaml's timeframe.

chosen_rationale.description: Lifted verbatim from backtest_spec.yaml's config_rationale, falling back to decision.yaml's rationale -- already LLM-authored, relocated to where code can find it.
